description: When flagging that Kapil Dabi had no existing contact record, reported 'this vault has no people/ directory at all' — checked only the Obsidian vault and concluded person files don't exist anywhere. In fact IES's own file map (SYSTEM.md) defines people/first-last.md as the canonical location for person files, and people/ exists on the local IES filesystem with a template (_template.md) and existing entries (e.g. aaron-baker.md, alice-mburu.md). Person records live in IES, not the Obsidian vault — conflated 'not in the vault' with 'doesn't exist.'
correction: Person files belong in {IES root}/people/YYYY... actually people/first-last.md per SYSTEM.md naming convention, not the Obsidian vault. Before declaring a data structure 'doesn't exist,' check the IES file map / SYSTEM.md for the canonical location, not just the most recently-used data source (Obsidian).
systemic_fix: When an agent needs to check for a person/contact record, check IES people/ first (per SYSTEM.md file map) before or in addition to the Obsidian vault. Don't assume the two knowledge stores are interchangeable.
